title: SCS-001 — Fix Stage 3 clip-detection timeout: cap input + increase timeout

tasks.description: Surgical edit to agents/scs001-clip-detection/index.ts: After line 51 (CONCURRENCY constant), add: const MAX_DISCOVERIES = parseInt(process.env.CLIP_DETECTION_MAX_INPUT ?? '20', 10); Then in the run() method (line ~136), replace 'for (const disc of discoveries)' with 'const capped = discoveries.slice(0, MAX_DISCOVERIES); for (const disc of capped)'. This caps LLM calls from 45 to 20, cutting stage 3 from >600s to ~200s.

Surgical edit to agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts line 632: change '3-clip-detection': 600_000 to '3-clip-detection': 900_000. This gives stage 3 a 50% longer timeout as a safety buffer even after the input cap.
